text: In 2019, Toronto Parking Authority embarked on a journey to implement a modernized Enterprise Resource Planning Solution to replace a system that was custom-built and implemented in the mid-1980s. The system had significant limitations and was approaching a state of obsolescence and was impairing the ability of the business to meet its financial mandate. Accordingly, Toronto Parking Authority initiated a comprehensive market scan, through a formal open Request for Information process, while taking into consideration the City of Toronto's "SAP First" policy to examine SAP before other Enterprise Resource Planning products in order to leverage existing investments in technology.
